notes.title: 7/11 多语言补丁更新 Multilingual patch
notes.notes:
增加了设置面板多种语言选项,妈妈再也不用担心我看不懂不同国家语言了~
目前支持
中文,
英文,
日语(一部分)
Added multiple language options in the Settings panel, and my mother no longer has to worry that I can't understand different languages
Currently support
Chinese,
English,
Japanese (part)
